ChangeNOW Announces NOW AI After Resolving Website Integration Vulnerability
summary: On October 15, with the help of independent security researchers, ChangeNOW identified a vulnerability affecting one of the integrations used on its website. The vulnerability has now been fixed. What We Know We currently have no evidence that the vulnerability was exploited. But we also can’t assume the researchers who reported it were the only […]
content: ChangeNOW has announced the launch of NOW AI following the successful resolution of a website integration vulnerability. The issue was identified on October 15 with the assistance of independent security researchers and has since been fixed. ChangeNOW stated there is currently no evidence that the vulnerability was exploited, though it cannot be guaranteed that the reporting researchers were the only ones who accessed it.
content_ta: ChangeNOW தனது இணையதள ஒருங்கிணைப்பு குறைபாடு சரிசெய்யப்பட்டதை அடுத்து NOW AI அறிமுகத்தை அறிவித்துள்ளது. சுதந்திரமான பாதுகாப்பு ஆராய்ச்சியாளர்களின் உதவியுடன் அக்டோபர் 15 அன்று இந்த குறைபாடு கண்டறிப்பட்டு தற்போது சரிசெய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த குறைபாடு தவறாகப் பயன்படுத்தப்பட்டதற்கான எந்த ஆதாரமும் தற்போது இல்லை என்று ChangeNOW தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: OCC Debanking Report Shows that Financial Services Firms Denied Services During Biden Administration
summary: Debanking, or denying access to financial services, is a nefarious activity that was far too prevalent during the prior administration. Numerous reports indicated that individuals and entities were denied services because of their political leanings or business operations deemed unsavory. Crypto or digital asset firms... Read More
tags: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
content: A new Office of the Comptroller of the Currency report highlights that financial services firms frequently denied access to accounts during the Biden administration. The practice, known as debanking, often targeted individuals and businesses due to their political views or specific business operations, including firms in the digital asset sector.
content_ta: Biden administration-ன் காலத்தில் நிதிச் சேவைகள் நிறுவனங்கள் பலரின் கணக்குகளைத் தொடர்ந்து மறுத்துள்ளதாக Office of the Comptroller of the Currency-ன் புதிய அறிக்கை தெரிவிக்கிறது. Debanking எனப்படும் இந்த நடவடிக்கை, அரசியல் கருத்துக்கள் அல்லது digital asset துறை உள்ளிட்ட குறிப்பிட்ட வணிக நடவடிக்கைகளின் காரணமாக தனிநபர்களையும் வணிகங்களையும் குறிவைத்தது.
